scope: Public original driver receipts and historical source only. No additional raw or recording scan occurred while making this addendum.

historicalRule.selection: combatPlan takes the first combatObservers peer with target and owner identities; its default nearbyObservers margin is 16. The separate action fanout probe uses stableFanoutRange.

limits: Positions are the latest actual driver-owned UserLocation receipts, not a continuous server pose trace.
The exact server execution order is not inferred from coincident wall timestamps.
Owner positive damage and launched receipt do not substitute for the missing mandatory observer Struck/Damage proof.
Native six-cell stability was not implemented in historical attack witness selection; any such new restriction is a new harness contract.
Other peers may be closer by owner receipts, but immediate visibility of both attack objects is not established here.
